prompt: A calendar invite arrived for a project kickoff next Tuesday. How should the agent handle this?
promptVariations: Decide how to triage this meeting invitation email.
You received a meeting invite for next week — what is the correct next action?

email.subject: Invitation: Q2 warehouse integration kickoff — Tue 21 Apr 10:00 CET
email.body: Hi, please accept if you can attend. Agenda: 1) Scope walkthrough, 2) API access, 3) Timeline. Meeting link attached.

rubric: Identifies this as a meeting invite and checks the user's calendar for conflicts before auto-accepting
If no conflict is known, proposes acceptance; never auto-accepts without surfacing to the user
Extracts agenda items into a short note for the user
Does not classify the message as spam
